_about: Shipped defaults. Don't edit this file for your own setup — put overrides in brand/brand.json (gitignored; see brand.example.json). The two are deep-merged, yours wins.
creator: Your Name

colors._note: Empty = the theme's palette (motion/themes/themes.json). Add accent / accent2 / bg / panel / text / muted to override, e.g. your brand color.

captions._note: The look comes from the theme. Override any key: font, size, uppercase, color, highlight, outline, outline_px, box, pop, max_words, max_chars, margin_v.

cameras._note: Framing per camera, in camera-region pixels (1920x1080). cam_crop = [x, y, w] 16:9 window for full-camera shots; bubble_crop = [x, y, size] square for the bubble. null = whole frame / centre square. Pick one per video with plan.json layout.camera; add your own presets in brand.json.

recording._note: OBS 'ISO canvas': one recording holds the captured window on top and the camera below, so they never drift. Regions are [x, y, w, h] in the recording. screen_app/screen_size: the window to capture — lock its content area to exactly screen_size (e.g. with a window-locking tool) and setup_obs --use finds it.

cuts._note: style = default auto-cut style for plan_cuts (override with --style). gentle suits screen demos (few, invisible cuts); tight is vlog-style jump cuts; none = manual cuts only.
